query:
UPDATE "Client" SET
               email = CASE WHEN $2::bool THEN $3::text ELSE email END,
               password = COALESCE($4, password),
               "trafficLimit" = COALESCE($5, "trafficLimit"),
               "expireAt" = CASE WHEN $6::bool THEN $7::timestamp ELSE "expireAt" END,
               banned = COALESCE($8, banned),
               "restrictionMode" = COALESCE($9, "restrictionMode"),
               note = CASE WHEN $10::bool THEN $11::text ELSE note END,
               protocols = COALESCE($12, protocols),
               "trafficResetDay" = CASE WHEN $13::bool THEN $14::int ELSE "trafficResetDay" END,
               "nextTrafficResetAt" = CASE WHEN $13::bool
                       THEN (CASE WHEN $14::int IS NULL THEN NULL
                                  ELSE $15::timestamp END)
                       ELSE "nextTrafficResetAt" END,
               "planId" = CASE WHEN $17::bool THEN $18::text ELSE "planId" END,
               "deviceLimit" = CASE WHEN $19::bool THEN $20::int ELSE "deviceLimit" END,
               "updatedAt" = $16
           WHERE id = $1
